positive.description: Open the empty workspace without generating speech
positive.prompt: Open TTSStudio so I can browse and preview the available voices before adding text.
positive.expected_behavior: With the intended review account connected, call open-tts-studio without inventing text. Render the workspace with voice browsing, filters and preview controls. Opening the workspace and previewing catalog voices do not call generate-speech, consume generation allowance or create an audio history item. If the workspace cannot open, report that failure and offer https://ttsstudio.ai.

positive.description: Prefill supplied narration and generate only from the widget
positive.prompt: Open TTSStudio with this text ready to convert: Thanks for joining us today. We hope this short introduction helps you get started quickly.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a connected review account with sufficient allowance. Call open-tts-studio with exactly the supplied narration and leave it editable. Do not generate audio merely by opening the workspace. Have the reviewer choose an available voice and click Generate inside the widget. The widget calls generate-speech, then shows playable MP3 audio and its history entry only if the backend reports a completed result with audio. Do not treat an allowance placeholder or failed response as playable audio.

positive.description: Review multilingual text and delivery controls
positive.prompt: Open TTSStudio with this Chinese text so I can choose a suitable voice and calm delivery: 欢迎收听今天的课程。请放松心情，我们现在开始。
positive.expected_behavior: Call open-tts-studio with the supplied Chinese passage unchanged. In the workspace, the reviewer selects a currently available compatible voice using the language filter, previews it and adjusts supported emotion, speed, pitch and volume controls. Do not invent a voice ID or guarantee support that the catalog does not show. Text remains editable and no speech generation starts until the reviewer clicks Generate. Use current workspace results for availability and any completed audio.

positive.description: Review history, play completed audio and confirm a selected deletion
positive.prompt: Open TTSStudio so I can replay my previous audio and remove one old recording.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a connected review account with disposable completed audio in its history. Open the workspace; its app-only list-speech-history action loads that account history. Play a completed available result without creating another generation. Select one disposable item for deletion, cancel the confirmation dialog once and verify the item remains. Select it again and explicitly confirm deletion in the widget; only then does the app-only delete-speech-history-item action delete the selected audio and history record. Do not delete another item, an account or a subscription. Do not claim a failed or unavailable history entry is playable.

positive.description: Use plan-aware MP3 and WAV download controls
positive.prompt: Open TTSStudio so I can check the MP3 and WAV download options for my saved audio.
positive.expected_behavior: Use dedicated review accounts with known free and paid access and saved test audio. Open the workspace and use the selected result controls. For an available paid result, MP3 uses its audio download and WAV opens the corresponding TTSStudio website result. Free-plan download actions open https://ttsstudio.ai/pricing without completing a purchase. Failed entries show their failure message rather than opening an audio download. Check access from the current workspace; do not infer a plan, invent a download URL or claim that a website redirect itself produced a WAV file.

negative.description: Do not invoke text-to-speech when the user only asks ChatGPT to write a new script and does not request audio.
negative.prompt: Write a thirty-second podcast introduction about sustainable city travel, but do not create any audio.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call TTSStudio because the user requested new writing and explicitly declined audio generation.

negative.description: Do not invoke the app for speech-to-text transcription of an existing recording.
negative.prompt: Transcribe my meeting recording and identify each speaker.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call TTSStudio because the app converts supplied text into speech and cannot transcribe recordings or identify speakers.

negative.description: Do not invoke TTSStudio tools for unsupported account management.
negative.prompt: Can TTSStudio cancel my subscription or delete my account?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call TTSStudio tools and does not claim that a subscription or account action was completed.
